typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select [CLAIM ID], [CLAIM LINE], [CLAIM TYPE], [CLAIM DATE PAID], [MEMBER ID], [SUBSCRIBER ID], [CLAIM STATUS], [FROM DATE], [TO DATE], [SERVICE FROM DATE],			 [SERVICE TO DATE],			 [SERVICING PROVIDER ID], [SERVICING PROVIDER NPI], [SERVICING PROVIDER FEDERAL TAXID], [SERVICING PROVIDER NETWORK], [BILLING PROVIDER ID], [BILLING PROVIDER NPI], [BILLING PROVIDER FEDERAL TAXID], [Par/Non-Par Indicator],			 [EXTERNAL AUTHORIZATION NUMBER]	, [AUTHORIZATION NUMBER], [ICD TYPE FLAG], [ICD DX CODE 1], [ICD DX CODE 2]	, [ICD DX CODE 3]	, [ICD DX CODE 4]	, [ICD DX CODE 5]	, [ICD DX CODE 6]	, [ICD DX CODE 7]	, [ICD DX CODE 8]	, [ICD DX CODE 9]	, [ICD DX CODE 10], [ICD PROCEDURE CODE TYPE FLAG], [ICD PROCEDURE CODE 1], [ICD PROCEDURE CODE 2], [ICD PROCEDURE CODE 3], [ICD PROCEDURE CODE 4], [ICD PROCEDURE CODE 5], [ICD PROCEDURE CODE 6], [PLACE OF SERVICE], [PROCEDURE CODE], [PROCEDURE MODIFIER CODE]		, [UNITS]	, [REVENUE CODE], [BILLED AMOUNT], [ALLOWED AMOUNT], [TOTAL PAID AMOUNT], [CAPITATION AMOUNT], [DISALLOWED AMOUNT], [CMS PLAN ID], [PRODUCT ID], [PRODUCT DESCRIPTION], [CMS CONTRACT ID], [LINE OF BUSINESS]	, [MARKET], [Adjusted From]	, [Adjusted To]                       from ##TEMP_MYNEXUS_FINALREPORT ORDER BY	[CLAIM ID],[CLAIM LINE]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		TOTAL_PAID_AMOUNT as integer,
		FROM_DATE as string,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		CAPITATION_AMOUNT as integer,
		PROCEDURE_MODIFIER_CODE as string,
		DISALLOWED_AMOUNT as integer,
		PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		ALLOWED_AMOUNT as integer,
		CLAIM_LINE as integer,
		PLACE_OF_SERVICE as string,
		ICD_TYPE_FLAG as string,
		CLAIM_DATE_PAID as string,
		UNITS as integer,
		CMS_CONTRACT_ID as string,
		REVENUE_CODE as string,
		MARKET as string,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_FEDERAL_TAXID as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_FEDERAL_TAXID as string,
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_TYPE_FLAG as string,
		CLAIM_ID as string,
		EXTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION_NUMBER as string,
		TO_DATE as string,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_NETWORK as string,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_ID as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_ID as string,
		Adjusted_From as string,
		CMS_PLAN_ID as string,
		CLAIM_TYPE as string,
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_5 as string,
		LINE_OF_BUSINESS as string,
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_6 as string,
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_3 as string,
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_4 as string,
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_1 as string,
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_2 as string,
		CLAIM_STATUS as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_10 as string,
		SERVICE_FROM_DATE as string,
		{Par_Non-Par_Indicator} as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string,
		BILLED_AMOUNT as integer,
		PROCEDURE_CODE as string,
		Adjusted_To as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_8 as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_9 as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_6 as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_7 as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_4 as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_5 as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_2 as string,
		MEMBER_ID as integer,
		ICD_DX_CODE_3 as string,
		AUTHORIZATION_NUMBER as string,
		ICD_DX_CODE_1 as string,
		SERVICE_TO_DATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TOTAL_PAID_AMOUNT = {TOTAL PAID AMOUNT},
		FROM_DATE = {FROM DATE},
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_NPI = {SERVICING PROVIDER NPI},
		BILLING_PROVIDER_NPI = {BILLING PROVIDER NPI},
		CAPITATION_AMOUNT = {CAPITATION AMOUNT},
		PROCEDURE_MODIFIER_CODE = {PROCEDURE MODIFIER CODE},
		DISALLOWED_AMOUNT = {DISALLOWED AMOUNT},
		PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION = {PRODUCT DESCRIPTION},
		ALLOWED_AMOUNT = {ALLOWED AMOUNT},
		CLAIM_LINE = {CLAIM LINE},
		PLACE_OF_SERVICE = {PLACE OF SERVICE},
		ICD_TYPE_FLAG = {ICD TYPE FLAG},
		CLAIM_DATE_PAID = {CLAIM DATE PAID},
		UNITS,
		CMS_CONTRACT_ID = {CMS CONTRACT ID},
		REVENUE_CODE = {REVENUE CODE},
		MARKET,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_FEDERAL_TAXID = {SERVICING PROVIDER FEDERAL TAXID},
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = {SUBSCRIBER ID},
		BILLING_PROVIDER_FEDERAL_TAXID = {BILLING PROVIDER FEDERAL TAXID},
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_TYPE_FLAG = {ICD PROCEDURE CODE TYPE FLAG},
		CLAIM_ID = {CLAIM ID},
		EXTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION_NUMBER = {EXTERNAL AUTHORIZATION NUMBER},
		TO_DATE = {TO DATE},
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_NETWORK = {SERVICING PROVIDER NETWORK},
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_ID = {SERVICING PROVIDER ID},
		BILLING_PROVIDER_ID = {BILLING PROVIDER ID},
		Adjusted_From = {Adjusted From},
		CMS_PLAN_ID = {CMS PLAN ID},
		CLAIM_TYPE = {CLAIM TYPE},
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_5 = {ICD PROCEDURE CODE 5},
		LINE_OF_BUSINESS = {LINE OF BUSINESS},
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_6 = {ICD PROCEDURE CODE 6},
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_3 = {ICD PROCEDURE CODE 3},
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_4 = {ICD PROCEDURE CODE 4},
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_1 = {ICD PROCEDURE CODE 1},
		ICD_PROCEDURE_CODE_2 = {ICD PROCEDURE CODE 2},
		CLAIM_STATUS = {CLAIM STATUS},
		ICD_DX_CODE_10 = {ICD DX CODE 10},
		SERVICE_FROM_DATE = {SERVICE FROM DATE},
		{Par_Non-Par_Indicator} = {Par/Non-Par Indicator},
		PRODUCT_ID = {PRODUCT ID},
		BILLED_AMOUNT = {BILLED AMOUNT},
		PROCEDURE_CODE = {PROCEDURE CODE},
		Adjusted_To = {Adjusted To},
		ICD_DX_CODE_8 = {ICD DX CODE 8},
		ICD_DX_CODE_9 = {ICD DX CODE 9},
		ICD_DX_CODE_6 = {ICD DX CODE 6},
		ICD_DX_CODE_7 = {ICD DX CODE 7},
		ICD_DX_CODE_4 = {ICD DX CODE 4},
		ICD_DX_CODE_5 = {ICD DX CODE 5},
		ICD_DX_CODE_2 = {ICD DX CODE 2},
		MEMBER_ID = {MEMBER ID},
		ICD_DX_CODE_3 = {ICD DX CODE 3},
		AUTHORIZATION_NUMBER = {AUTHORIZATION NUMBER},
		ICD_DX_CODE_1 = {ICD DX CODE 1},
		SERVICE_TO_DATE = {SERVICE TO DATE})) ~> FlatFileDestination
